full.description: This image is a photomicrograph of brain tissue from the nervous system, stained with immunohistochemistry. It shows brown-stained viral inclusions or antigens within the neural tissue. The findings are characteristic of herpes simplex virus encephalitis. The blue counterstained cells represent the background cellular architecture of the brain.

random.description: This is a micrograph of brain tissue. The section exhibits brown immunohistochemical staining highlighting pathological changes within the central nervous system. Specifically, the stained structures indicate neurodegenerative changes, such as tau-positive neurofibrillary tangles or similar inclusions. These findings are characteristic of specific neurodegenerative disorders involving abnormal protein accumulation in the brain.
